mission.statement: We are building an educational platform where knowledge turns into practice. Our programs combine a theoretical foundation with hands-on work on prosthetic models and various types of specialized equipment — exactly as it happens in real-world conditions when working with patients.

history.title: History
paragraphs: Protez Academy was founded in 2023 as the educational branch of Protez Foundation, in response to the need for systemic development of prosthetics, orthotics, and multidisciplinary rehabilitation in Ukraine.

After launching prosthetic centers and working with a large number of patients, the team realized that quality recovery requires not only modern technologies, but also well-trained specialists, the exchange of practical experience, and continuous professional education.
That is how Protez Academy was formed — a platform that combines education, clinical practice, and expert collaboration.

During this time, 150 specialists have already completed training abroad and gained the knowledge and practical tools that help them work confidently and effectively. But for us, this is only the beginning.
